extraction.Name: Albert Whipple
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 11, 1918, by Kilgore State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Deeded June 11, 1918, to Alexander Whipple for $1500.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612701 issued; Southeast quarter section 21, township 39, north of range 32. Receipt was signed but not dated. Document also contains a second allotment record: Allotment No. 1447, Jacob Schweigman and Lane J. Thomas, Rosebud S.D., Southwest quarter section 33, township 36, north of range 29, Fee patent No. 612696 issued December 29, 1917, receipt signed by allottee January 28, 1918, patent recorded April 24, 1918, land conveyed by deed dated January 29, 1920, for $1.00 and other valuable consideration to Abraham Slimmer Bartine.
